content: Server-side bot detection for OG-tag injection is done via User-Agent regex matching against known bot signatures (facebookexternalhit, Twitterbot, Slackbot, LinkedInBot, Discordbot, WhatsApp, TelegramBot, Googlebot, etc.). npm package 'isbot' maintains a regularly-updated regex list for exactly this purpose. Caveat: UA-based detection is trivially spoofable and should never gate security-sensitive logic (only used to decide whether to serve an HTML page with OG meta tags vs. issue a redirect) -- it must never bypass password/expiration checks.
